Strategy: Combine the gated gentle fifteen sweet band with a firmer mid penalty of twenty and an exact-fit bonus. This stacks three preferences that each helped alone, but the stronger penalty may hurt genuinely tight fits.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [1000.0 if r - item == 0 else (-(r - item) + (15 if len(bins) >= 5 and r - item >= 30 and r - item <= 45 else 0) - (20 if r - item >= 8 and r - item <= 22 else 0)) for r in bins]
```
